editorial.blurb: Phở Cafe serves up generous, affordable Vietnamese bowls and crispy Thai-style appetizers that hit the spot when you're in the neighborhood craving bold, comforting flavors.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the house special pho with its variety of meat cuts, and ask for extra sides of cilantro, onions, and jalapeños upfront—the kitchen is more responsive to requests made at the start of your order.
